errors.text_span: За 2017 г. липсва процентен етикет. Стойностите за ръста започват от 14% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 14% growth value corresponds to the year 2018. In the chart, the 14% label is positioned between the 2017 and 2018 ticks, visually closer to 2018, but it represents the growth from 2017 to 2018. A more accurate description would be to associate it with the period between the two years or with the end of that period (2018). However, the image shows a label for 14% that seems to be related to the start of the growth, and my calculations confirm that (10.8 - 9.5) / 9.5 ≈ 14%. The percentage value for 2017 is explicitly shown on the chart as 14%.
The description claims there is no percentage label for 2017, but the chart clearly shows a "14%" label positioned above the starting point of the growth line, between the 2017 and 2018 tick marks.
